assist.changedStrategy: Used a newer SEC-filed current report to test whether the prior technical-milestone uncertainty changed, rather than repeating the earlier cumulative Beta thesis.

scope: Bounded structural/risk support only; no numeric underwriting, score, rank, tick, membership, or Chief disposition.

claims.claim: Infleqtion reported a demonstration of 30 entangled logical qubits on its Sqale quantum computer on September 24, 2026, which is evidence of technical progress against a previously open milestone uncertainty but does not by itself establish customer economics, scalable commercial deployment, or economic quantum advantage.
claims.interpretation: The technical falsifier moved favorably: the specific 30-logical-qubit milestone is no longer merely a forward target. The successor evidentiary bottleneck is independent reproducibility plus workload/customer economics and scale.

claims.claim: The September 24 disclosure was furnished under Item 7.01 rather than filed for Section 18 liability purposes, so Alpha should preserve a source-quality distinction between the SEC-hosted disclosure and audited/periodic financial evidence when converting the milestone into confidence or risk treatment.
claims.interpretation: This is not a contradiction or present blocker; it is a provenance-quality qualifier and a reason to seek independent or customer-level verification before treating the milestone as commercial proof.

sources.use: cumulative baseline retained from packet lineage

risks: Technical milestone achievement can still fail to convert into economic advantage or scalable customer deployments.
Issuer-furnished milestone disclosure remains weaker evidence for commercial economics than customer, independent benchmark, or periodic financial evidence.
unknowns: Independent reproduction or third-party validation of the 30-entangled-logical-qubit result.
Customer workload performance and economics versus classical substitutes.
Conversion of the milestone into recurring commercial revenue and durable margins.
falsifiers: Independent benchmark evidence fails to reproduce the claimed logical-qubit performance under comparable conditions.
Customer deployments show no economic or workload advantage after accounting for control, error-correction and infrastructure overhead.
Technical progress continues without measurable conversion into repeatable commercial deployments or recurring revenue.
